name: ZX_TAX_LINES_INTERFACE
description: This table stores external transaction tax lines to be imported into tax repository directly.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Transaction line identifier

columns.name: INTERFACE_TAX_LINE_ID
columns.description: Column to temporarily store identifier of the interface line corresponding to this tax line

columns.name: INTERFACE_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Column to temporarily store entity code of the tax line interface table

columns.name: TAX_LINE_ALLOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether ZX_TRX_TAX_LINK_GT contains allocations of  this imported tax line to multiple transaction lines

columns.name: EXEMPT_CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Tax exemption certificate number

columns.name: EXEMPT_REASON_CODE

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPTION_ID
columns.description: Tax exemption identifier for this tax line

columns.name: TAX_EXCEPTION_ID
columns.description: Tax exception identifier for this tax line

columns.name: TAX_RATE_ID

columns.name: TAX_AMT_INCLUDED_FLAG

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction code for this tax line

columns.name: TAX_AMT

columns.name: TAX_RATE

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE

columns.name: TAX

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: LOAD_STATUS
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request status of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Alphanumeric identifier on a transaction.

columns.description: Application short name of the transaction.
